title: Minimal modularity lifting for GSp₄ in nonregular weight

readme:
Construct minimal modularity lifting for ordinary symplectic rank-four Galois representations in nonregular Siegel weight (a,2), using cuspidal coherent cohomology in degrees zero and one, corrected Fourier doubling, Klingen Taylor–Wiles comparison and selected-module balance. Add characteristic-zero singular-weight interpolation, ordinary p-adic family lifting and the four-chamber weight-two rank-one/classicality argument. Keep the minimal balanced, p-adic family and characteristic-zero higher-Hida branches distinct, and expose every unresolved proof gate and supplier contract.

The detailed roadmap is research/blueprint/readmes/GSp4NonregularModularityLifting.md. All twelve layers are planned at target level; no layer is claimed closed. The minimal balanced-module theorem, ordinary p-adic family theorem and characteristic-zero classical theorem retain the exact hypotheses and proof gates stated there.

Conventions: geometric Frobenius; cyclotomic character ε has Hodge–Tate weight −1; full symplectic multiplier retained; Ω(k,r)=ω(k+r,r). The BCGP25 arithmetic spin and coherent dual-spin conventions are explicitly compared. General deformation, Hida, compactification and Hecke-determinant machinery belongs to the named suppliers.

Sources: Calegari–Geraghty (2020), Pilloni (2020, cleared author version), Pilloni (September 2009 author version of the 2012 paper), Pilloni–Stroh, Mok, and Boxer–Calegari–Gee–Pilloni (2021/2025 author versions). All claims below are in our own words, with version-specific theorem/section/page locators.

stages.title: Conventions, residual data and tame levels
stages.description: Fix the full multiplier and the weight/Frobenius dictionaries, the four-factor ordinary-root condition, the exact CG residual/local data and the q-enlarged minimal tame level. Specify symplectically labelled Klingen Taylor–Wiles refinements, including their product separation. Generic Galois and deformation objects are imported.

stages.title: Selected cuspidal Hecke images
stages.description: Construct the specialized anemic, full and p-enlarged Hecke images on the actual cuspidal modules, their invariant-level restrictions and joint generalized-root selectors. Define nonzero cuspidal Katz modularity at the prescribed level. The underlying image, determinant and projector theory is imported from the current upstream Hecke roadmap.

stages.title: Singular-weight Galois interpolation
stages.description: Construct number fields for coherent eigensystems and apply the all-degree Pilloni–Stroh interpolation to their characteristic-zero actions. State the precise qualified Mok crystalline specialization, the no-Steinberg scalar-weight obstruction, ordinary weight-two Galois systems, the pure general-type monodromy upgrade, dual-spin overconvergent interpolation and completed-eigenspace isotypy through the GSp₄ semisimplicity criteria. Preserve every classification and local qualification.

stages.title: Finite-level Hasse transfer and regular Galois systems
stages.description: Use supplied Hasse lifts with finite-level congruences and vanishing thresholds to transfer actual selected image quotients. The annihilator belongs to the selected summand. Construct central characters, residual Galois systems and regular Hecke-valued representations with ordered ordinary local characters. A stronger p-polynomial identity is recorded separately as a proof gap.

stages.title: Cuspidal Fourier doubling
stages.description: Specialize the formal U,Z,Z₂,X₂ operators and Hasse spaces in characteristic p. Prove ordinary-envelope control and the two kernel systems. Use corrected scalar/vector theta inputs, an all-index contraction obligation and a separately checked scalar recurrence to obtain both root-labelled Hasse-projection injections. Keep all needed weight bounds and restrict the minimal-discriminant argument to cuspidal forms.

stages.title: Nonregular Hecke-valued minimal deformations
stages.description: Use the two independent ordinary lines in the same reconstructed representation to obtain its invariant unramified isotropic two-plane. Construct compatible selected finite-quotient Galois deformations, normalize the full multiplier and pass to the inverse limit. Verify every minimal local condition before invoking the universal classifying map.

stages.title: Klingen Taylor–Wiles level control
stages.description: Construct the labelled Klingen block projector. Prove the high-weight integral pullback/trace comparison, with inverse (tr∘pr_Q∘i)⁻¹∘tr rather than the degree-normalized trace, descend through Hasse and secondary-Hasse strata with explicit H¹ reverse induction, and induct over O/ϖᵐ before passing to E/O. Separate this degree-zero comparison from the BCGP21 derived comparison and module-coinvariant supplier interface.

stages.title: Coherent defect and the selected balance gate
stages.description: Identify the dual cuspidal module via L=ω(1,3−a) and supplied integral coherent duality. Deduce torsion-freeness from the appropriate H² vanishing and reduce whole-module balance to the supplied localized characteristic-zero dimension equality. The boundary/Arthur argument belongs to IntegralCoherentHeckeComplexes. State the additional integral p-idempotent and selected-rank obligations needed to prove balance of the αβ summand.

stages.title: Conditional minimal lifting and examples
stages.description: Assemble the GSp4 balanced patching datum, including its fixed-multiplier diamond-inertia identity and universal augmentation kernel. Deduce Rmin=T and positive-rank dual cuspidal freeness under the corrected proof gates, then the a≥4 and crystalline classical corollaries at the actual minimal level. Keep scalar-weight H² vanishing and the mod-2 illustration conjectural; check the Weil-restriction and local level examples with their exact limitations.

stages.title: Ordinary p-adic lifting in families
stages.description: Specialize Pilloni’s admissibility data, keeping its image conditions distinct and its ordered-flag discrepancy explicit. Import Hida horizontal control and generic deformation/defect-zero patching to prove ordinary variable-weight R=T and integral-weight specialization. Deduce ordinary cuspidal p-adic modularity and the parallel GL2-parabolic variant, without asserting classicality of singular specializations.

stages.title: Characteristic-zero higher-Hida patching
stages.description: Fix the distinct BCGP25 weight-two and integral-enormity data, including its dyadic neat-prime condition. Construct four localized higher-Hida modules and their two-direction torus diamonds, prove weight/diamond freeness, construct the full-multiplier deformation action (with the GSp₄ coefficient descent valid at p=2, BCGP25 Lemma 7.4.8) and the projective Satake coinvariant comparison. Apply a corrected open-ideal patching theorem to obtain local freeness at the characteristic-zero point; rank zero remains possible.

stages.title: Rank one and classical weight-two lifting
stages.description: Define the two-wall R-regular weight condition and compute multiplicity one only at nonzero regular points on the relevant component. Retain all five conditions of each dyadic/odd automorphic-seed alternative. Prove support through the singular point using the appropriate regular ordinary lifting and solvable descent suppliers, then rank one separately in all four chambers. Apply the image/de Rham/four-multiplicity higher-Coleman criterion to deduce classical weight-two modularity, retaining all unresolved proof gates.
